Dashboard.description: Here's a quick overview of your Outpost account.

Profile.title: Profile
Profile.description: Manage your personal information and account security.
Profile.editAvatarDescription: Upload a new profile picture. Recommended size is 200x200px.

avatar.fileTooLarge: File is too large. Maximum size is 2MB.
avatar.invalidFileType: Invalid file type. Please use PNG, JPG, or WEBP.
avatar.genericError: An unknown error occurred. Please try again.
avatar.successDescription: Your avatar has been successfully updated.

form.title: Edit Profile
form.phoneDescription: Select your country and enter your phone number.
form.phoneInvalid: Please enter a valid phone number.
form.zoneinfoDescription: Select the timezone you are in.
form.successDescription: Your profile has been successfully updated.
form.errorDescription: Could not update your profile. Please try again.

passwordForm.title: Change Password
passwordForm.description: Choose a strong new password to keep your account secure.
passwordForm.successDescription: Your password has been successfully changed.

verification.title: Verify Attributes
verification.description: Verify your contact information to secure your account.
verification.emailSentDescription: A verification email has been sent to {email}.
verification.phoneSentDescription: A verification SMS has been sent to {phone}.

twoFactor.title: Two-Factor Authentication
twoFactor.description: Add an extra layer of security to your account.
twoFactor.statusDisabled: Enhance your account security by enabling two-factor authentication.
twoFactor.qrInstructions: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app.
twoFactor.manualEntryInstructions: Or, enter this secret key into your authenticator app manually.
twoFactor.secretCopiedDescription: The manual setup key has been copied to your clipboard.
twoFactor.otpSuccessDescription: 2FA via authenticator app has been successfully enabled.
twoFactor.mfaDisabledDescription: 2FA via authenticator app has been disabled.
twoFactor.passkeysDescriptionRedirect: Manage your passkeys on the secure page provided by our identity service. You will be redirected to add or remove passkeys.
twoFactor.passkeysEnabled: Passkeys are enabled on your account.
twoFactor.passkeysDisabled: Passkeys are not yet enabled on your account.

passkeyError.title: Configuration Error
passkeyError.description: Passkey management is not configured correctly. Please contact support.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.description: Manage your account and appearance settings.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Customize the look and feel of your account.

Login.title: Sign in to Outpost
Login.description: Use your company's single sign-on (SSO) to continue.
Login.errorDescription: Could not sign in. Please try again or contact support.
